findings.evidenceJa: 成功率一桁
findings.governingReading: a success rate in the single digits
findings.explanation: A single-digit percentage becomes the nonsensical “.01 digits,” radically changing Shirou’s prior success rate.

findings.evidenceJa: 同調開始
findings.governingReading: synchronization start
findings.explanation: 同調 is misread as emotional sympathy inside a technical contrast with Projection Start.

findings.highlight: if it still works on me
findings.evidenceJa: 自分自身に働きかける意味さえ同じなら
findings.governingReading: so long as its meaning—acting upon myself—remains the same
findings.explanation: The condition concerns the incantation’s meaning and target; the English substitutes whether the spell remains effective.

findings.highlight: I remove the nerve inside my spine
findings.evidenceJa: 背骨に抉り込んだ感覚を外す
findings.governingReading: I disengage the sensation gouged into my spine
findings.explanation: Shirou stops the induced sensation; the English says he physically removes a nerve.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはまったくです、なんて珍しく軽口を言って
findings.governingReading: Saber unusually jokes, “Quite,”
findings.explanation: Saber’s rare participation in Shirou’s light teasing is reduced to neutral agreement.

findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣の教え
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu’s teaching, with his name read affectionately as “Dad”
findings.explanation: The name-and-ruby layering that joins Kiritsugu’s identity to Shirou’s familial address disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 楽しむ時は思いっきり楽しむ
findings.governingReading: when it was time to have fun, enjoy it with all your heart
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s maxim about wholehearted conduct is reduced to enjoying preferred things.

findings.highlight: might have been the best time of my life
findings.evidenceJa: 純粋に楽しい時間だったのかもしれない
findings.governingReading: may have been a time of pure happiness for me
findings.explanation: The English changes a tentative characterization of the period’s emotional quality into a superlative life ranking.

findings.evidenceJa: とんでもない老人
findings.governingReading: an outrageous old man
findings.explanation: A comic evaluation of the old man’s behavior is mistaken for extreme age.

findings.highlight: if you are to follow your Master’s order
findings.evidenceJa: 己が主の命を守るのなら
findings.governingReading: if you mean to protect your own Master’s life
findings.explanation: Saber’s warning invokes Rin’s life; the English substitutes obedience to an order.

findings.highlight: a circuit you have not used before
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで在ったというのに使われていなかった回路
findings.governingReading: a circuit that had existed all along but had never been used
findings.explanation: The crucial correction—that Shirou’s circuit preexisted rather than being newly made—is omitted.

findings.highlight: I feel a definite thumping from my numb body
findings.evidenceJa: どくどくと脈打つ確かな鼓動を聞き届ける
findings.governingReading: I register the unmistakable, pounding pulse from the half of my body that had been insensible all day
findings.explanation: The first concrete return of sensation loses the pulse, its pounding rhythm, and the all-day duration.

findings.evidenceJa: 体が動く頃には
findings.governingReading: by the time your body can move again
findings.explanation: Archer predicts the point when Shirou can move, not complete healing.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺の刀
findings.governingReading: my blade
findings.explanation: Archer refers to one blade; the English changes it to plural swords.

findings.highlight: You claim not to have any ideals
findings.evidenceJa: 理想を抱くなと言うおまえ
findings.governingReading: you, who tell me not to embrace an ideal
findings.explanation: Shirou challenges Archer’s injunction; the English instead says Archer claims to possess no ideals himself.

findings.evidenceJa: 大義
findings.governingReading: great causes
findings.explanation: Archer dismisses public causes; the English substitutes justice itself, changing the target of his list.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな不確かな意義など偽物だ
findings.governingReading: such uncertain grounds for meaning are false
findings.explanation: Archer calls those grounds counterfeit; the English changes falsity into lack of utility or meaning.

findings.evidenceJa: 人を叶える
findings.governingReading: brings a person to fulfillment
findings.explanation: The unusual verb links fulfillment to the person themself; “saves” collapses it into the salvation term Archer is qualifying.

findings.evidenceJa: 本人の意思と結果
findings.governingReading: the person’s own will and its result
findings.explanation: The result of personal will becomes actions, altering Archer’s stated condition for fulfillment.

findings.evidenceJa: 死ぬまで繰り返す
findings.governingReading: repeat it until the day you die
findings.explanation: Archer predicts a compulsive recurring pattern; the English changes it into continued pursuit of one ideal.
